audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 through 6 all read 'Skill' (row 6 'Vayne') in both layers while the packet chart has a real see-saw: Vayne / Volibear / Volibear / Vayne / Volibear / Vayne / Volibear. The content whys already described exactly that see-saw, so the win[] tokens were contradicting the sentence printed next to them on six of seven rows.
audit.why: The swings are mechanical: you own 2-3 once Thundering Smash (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) plus Frenzied Maul (5s) are up, she takes 4-5 back on her attack-speed window with Condemn down to 14s, you retake 6 because Stormbringer's slow beats Tumble, she takes first item on Silver Bolts' third-hit max-health true damage, and you retake 2+ items as the durable diver against a squishy carry.
audit.corrected: All six rows set to the packet sides in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match (row 3 and 5 down to 4/10, row 4 to 6/10, row 6 to 6/10), and phases[0]/[3]/[5].why rewritten so they stop claiming a Volibear win on rows she takes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why credited Sundered Sky with owning the first-item stage, which is the stage Vayne actually takes.
audit.why: Silver Bolts deals a percentage of max health as true damage on every third consecutive hit and ignores armour entirely, so stacking resistances and heal does not answer her first attack-speed item. Sundered Sky's heal does not out-race percent-max-health true damage.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now says her first attack-speed item plus Silver Bolts out-races the heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's abilities were mis-named across five fields: whys[1], spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] call Q a 'knock-up', and spikes[1].text and wants.you[1] give E a 'stun'.
audit.why: Thundering Smash (Q) stuns and damages the first enemy he attacks — it is a stun, not a displacement, so it does not enable knockup-dependent follow-ups. Sky Splitter (E, 16s, 1200 range) deals damage, slows, and shields Volibear only if he stands in the blast radius; it has no stun at all. Telling a player to 'save E to stun' is advice for an ability that does not exist, and against Vayne the wasted beat is the whole trade.
audit.corrected: Q named as Thundering Smash / the Q stun in whys[1], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and wants.you[0]; wants.you[1] now uses E's real effect, the slow.

audit.why: Condemn's knockback only stuns on terrain collision, which is why wants.you[2] ('fight in tight spaces so Condemn walls her, not you') is correct as written. Whether Condemn's knockback strips Thundering Smash's pending stun buff is not in Riot's text — the mirror declined to assert it and so do I.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade, but Tumble poke and Silver Bolts' third-hit true damage chunk you well before you can reach her at all.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Vayne down every time Condemn is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Her attack-speed spike and Condemn (14s at rank 4) let her kite the double-bite; walk up only with the wall behind her, not you.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Vayne to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Her first attack-speed item plus Silver Bolts' max-health true damage out-races your heal — Sundered Sky alone will not hold it.

edits.before: Level 2 flips to Volibear as your Q knock-up finally lets you catch and punish her.
edits.after: Level 2 flips to Volibear as Thundering Smash's stun lets you catch and punish her.

edits.before: Once you have Q knock-up you can catch her Tumble (Q) and stick — but her level-4 spike with Silver Bolts and Condemn window lets her kite and wall-stun you.
edits.after: Once you have Thundering Smash you can catch her Tumble (Q) and stick — but her level-4 spike with Silver Bolts and Condemn window lets her kite and wall-stun you.

edits.before: Stormbringer's slow negates her kiting; use R to close and E to stun before she can Tumble away or Condemn you into a wall.
edits.after: Stormbringer's slow negates her kiting; leap in and land Thundering Smash's stun before she can Tumble away or Condemn you into a wall.

edits.before: Close with Q knock-up before she Tumbles
edits.after: Close with the Q stun before she Tumbles

edits.before: Save E stun to cancel her repositioning
edits.after: Save E slow to punish her repositioning

notes: The biggest correction here is an ability-identity error repeated in five fields: Volibear's Q was called a knock-up and his E was given a stun. Sky Splitter has no stun — it slows, damages, and shields him only when he stands in the blast — so 'save E stun to cancel her repositioning' told the player to hold a button that does nothing. Level chart realigned to the packet on six rows in both layers; the content whys already described the correct see-saw, so this closes a two-answers-on-one-page bug rather than changing the actual advice.
